entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to start a return. Order number is 772-B-901.

I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Level Cycling Shoes. To make sure I understand, is there a technical fault with the item or is it a matter of preference?
They don't fit. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks. They're giving me terrible blisters. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters from new cycling shoes is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Just one moment while I check the return eligibility.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return them or not?

Yes, absolutely. I see here the order was delivered 56 days ago, and our policy allows for returns on these items for up to 90 days. You are well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now.
Okay, good. So you'll email me a label?

Correct. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email on file. As soon as we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble, I've gone ahead and added a credit for free 2-day shipping to your account for your next purchase.
Oh. Okay, that's helpful. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
